verdict.rationale: Square provides an official Mobile Payments SDK for iOS/Android (square-docs-4) with Tap to Pay on iPhone support (square-docs-2), offline payments handling (square-docs-5), and Terminal API for hardware-based in-person payments (square-docs-28, square-docs-26), all backed by first-party developer docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the mobile SDK integration experience and explicit Android-specific in-person payment documentation beyond offline payments.
